rewatch_engineering.loop_trick: Red flash + record scratch + 'Your teacher lied' frame at 0:00 matches identical red flash + scratch at 0:26-28; loop is invisible
rewatch_engineering.hidden_detail: Tiny citation watermark in corner of library scene reads 'Cambridge ESOL, 2019, n=400' - too small to read once, viewers screenshot on watch #2
rewatch_engineering.punchline_reveal: Opens 'Your teacher lied' (accusation). Closes 'They just don't know what nobody told them' (empathy). Same words mean different things
rewatch_engineering.info_density: 4 statistics in 28 seconds (400 learners, 2 years, half/half split, 4x faster) - viewers scrub back to verify
rewatch_engineering.visual_rhythm: Kick drum cuts on each word of 'Four. Times. Faster.' Captions punch in on the same beats

beats.visual: Single-frame red flash (#E63946) -> hard cut to dark grade of stack of grammar textbooks
beats.caption: YOUR TEACHER LIED

beats.visual: Slow dolly through vintage Cambridge-style library, dust motes, warm amber light. Hidden citation watermark in bottom-right corner: 'Cambridge ESOL, 2019, n=400' at 8% opacity
beats.caption: CAMBRIDGE | 400 LEARNERS | 2 YEARS
beats.voice_line: Cambridge tracked four hundred English learners for two years.

beats.visual: Split screen: left side - hand circling grammar workbook; right side - silhouette speaking with sound waves
beats.caption: GRAMMAR vs SPEAKING
beats.voice_line: Half did extra grammar drills. Half did extra speaking practice.

beats.visual: Right side glows GOLD; left side fades to grey. Yellow stat overlay slams in: '4x FASTER'
beats.caption: 4x FASTER
beats.voice_line: The speakers became fluent four times faster.

beats.visual: Big yellow text on black: 'FOUR.' -> 'TIMES.' -> 'FASTER.' Each word is its own cut, kick drum sync
beats.caption: FOUR. | TIMES. | FASTER.

beats.visual: Animation: open paper map -> a foot stepping next to it. Map remains static; foot keeps walking
beats.caption: GRAMMAR is a map. | You don't WALK by reading maps.
beats.voice_line: Grammar is a map. But you don't learn to walk by reading maps.

beats.visual: Stopwatch at 20:00 -> swap to silhouette speaking
beats.caption: TRADE | 20 min grammar | for | 20 min SPEAKING
beats.voice_line: Trade twenty minutes of grammar today for twenty minutes of speaking.

beats.visual: Soft fade to a teacher silhouette holding a textbook. Dim lighting, sympathetic framing
beats.caption: Your teacher isn't lying. | They just weren't told.
beats.voice_line: Your teacher isn't lying. They just don't know what nobody told them.

beats.visual: Single-frame red flash repeats (matches first frame for loop). Yellow text: '4x FASTER'
beats.caption: 4x FASTER
